children: Sienna reported Q3 and nine-month 2026 results and expects full-year 2026 long-term care same-property NOI growth, excluding retroactive items, in the high-single-digit range, up from its prior mid- to high-single-digit target.
2026 LTC NOI growth target raised to high single digits
The target was previously mid- to high-single digits; the higher outlook signals improved expected performance in long-term care.
Retirement NOI growth expected to exceed 10% in 2026
This is a forward target; the release attributes growth to occupancy, rate increases and higher care revenue.
ATM program renewed, allowing up to $150M in share issuance
Shares may be issued at the company’s discretion to fund growth, creating potential dilution.
Q3 same-property operating margins rose ~200 bps YoY
The reported improvement supports the retirement segment outlook; no comparable margin figure was provided for the prior period.

The raised long-term care target and retirement growth outlook extend Sienna’s reported trend of 15 consecutive quarters of growth. Delivery against the 2026 segment targets and any ATM share issuance will determine whether the outlook becomes a larger catalyst.
from Sienna Senior Living Inc. distributed by GlobeNewswire.
